notes: Searches: all 6 used, so discovery stopped there. Fetches: 42 of 60. Upcoming coverage is thin: no upcoming shows found in Wyoming or South Dakota, only the Oct 24 Grand Forks show in North Dakota, and only the June 2027 Billings show in Montana. Most other shows surfaced on never-fetch listing sites (treasurehunter, cardshopfinder, cantonfair), so they are leads, not checked. Past shows not recorded because no size appeared on an allowed page: Black Hills Card Show in Rapid City (Sept 2026), Great Plains Cards and Collectibles in Garretson (Sept 6, 2026), AMA Fall show in Sioux Falls (Sept 12 to 13, 2026), Kirkwood Mall in Bismarck (Aug 8 to 9, 2026), The 4 C's in Bismarck (Sept 11, 2026), Missoula Sports Cards and Collectibles show (Apr 18 to 19, 2026), Cheyenne shows (May 22 to 24 and Aug 8 to 9, 2026), Minneapolis Trading Card Fest (Oct 17 to 18, 2026), Collect-A-Con Minneapolis (July 18 to 19, 2026), and Duluth shows (June 2026). The cardsota all-events calendar (not a never-fetch site) lists about 20 Minnesota rows and the Grand Forks row. Its rows carry weekday and day but no year. The weekdays match 2026, but I did not write years, so those rows are leads. Search-summary claims with no checkable source URL were not recorded: a Pokemon event at Hyatt Regency Bloomington on Dec 13, 2026; a sports card show at a Holiday Inn in Fargo on June 20 (no year); the venue for the Card Collectors Anonymous show; and the Andover Community Center venue. Montana Fun Con page shows ZIP 59102 for MetraPark, which I did not record because no street address was given and I could not confirm the ZIP. Event type is convention for the Minnesota Card Show (four days, dealers plus guest signings) and card_show for the Montana show (a card show run during Billings Fun Con). Dead or unreachable: cardcollectorsanonymous.com, stationkicks.com, kaboomcards.com and visitfargomoorhead.com (host does not resolve), zootownsportscards.com and visitcheyenne.com and visitsiouxfalls.com (HTTP 404), visitmissoula.org (TLS name mismatch), and the visitsaintpaul.com event page (redirect target 404). Tourism calendars for Grand Forks, Bismarck, Rapid City and Sioux Falls listed no card shows. Out of scope for this brief per the known list: SCG CON Minneapolis and the Star Wars Unlimited Minneapolis qualifier.
